g.text: ASP.NET Core MVC (.NET 10) / EF Core 10 (LazyLoadingProxies) + PostgreSQL / Cookie & Google OAuth 2.0 / QuestPDF + QRCoder (AES)

svg.text: PRESENTATION LAYER / Razor Views • Bootstrap 5 Dark • jQuery AJAX
Interactive hall seat grid (Available / VIP / Reserved) → CreateOrder
Renders newly booked tickets for the active order
• Sign in with Google button → POST /Account/GoogleLogin
• Navigation link to local registration view
Fields: Email, Password, ConfirmPassword, Name, Surname, PhoneNumber, Birthday
Client & server validation via DataAnnotations + jQuery Unobtrusive
• Native browser PDF renderer for embedded tickets
Requests routed through ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline
APPLICATION LAYER / Pipeline • Controllers • Services • DTOs • Integrations
DI: Database db • Instantiates: new TicketService()
3. Filters by Place.VIP and BeginningTime > Now
4. Generates PDFs on the fly (TicketService) → TicketDto
4. QuestPDF A4 in-memory (VIP Dark / Std Light)
DI: Database db • HttpClient (Google People API)
Triggers Google challenge if anonymous; else redirects to Main
2. HTTP GET → Google People API (phone, birthday)
3. Upserts Viewer in db.Viewers → Authenticate() → Main
Validates unique Email → inserts Viewer → Cookie sign-in
In-memory A4 PDF rendering + PNG QR code generation

g.text: / 15 DbSet<T> + 1 Join Table (MovieGenres) / UseLazyLoadingProxies() / EnableRetryOnFailure() / PostgreSQL

svg.text: READ: Rentals, Movies, Screenings, Halls, Reserveds
R/W: Screenings, Viewers, Places, Reserveds, Tickets
DATA LAYER / All 15 Entities + MovieGenres Join Table (PostgreSQL • EF Core)
Idempotently populates initial reference & catalog data:
• Movies: 10 sample titles with local poster assets
Note: Viewers, Reserveds, and Tickets are created
dynamically at runtime through user flows.
Navigation properties are marked virtual, allowing
Razor views (Main, Details, Partial) to resolve related
collections on demand via proxy interceptors.
explicit FK properties — EF Core auto-generates
nullable CinemaId?, MovieId?, and HallId? columns.
The C# class defines a typo property ReserverdId,
causing EF Core to create a separate shadow FK
Details → AJAX seat map → GET CreateOrder →
(15m TTL) + Ticket → AES + QR + QuestPDF → Base64.
• Local Viewer.Password is stored without hashing
• TicketService uses a zeroed 16-byte AES IV
• CreateOrder mutates state over HTTP GET
• No background cleanup for expired Reserved.ExpireAt
• TicketService instantiated via new instead of DI
• Cinema and Hall have no direct FK relation
